note: The bid-tab basis and the bid overlay over our direct cost (D-1273, revising D-1103). Every percentage is an input: intelcost-infra/bidtabs/basis-report.mjs reads this file and nothing in the script repeats a figure. No tab figure lives here.

basis.escalationNote: Tabs are compared as bid. No ECI escalation (D-1103's escalation is withdrawn).
basis.recentNote: The tuning set: tabs bid within this many months of the newest tab's bid month (bid month >= newest month - recentMonths). Older tabs are reported as history only.
basis.biddersNote: Every bidder on the tab, each priced on the same pay items as ours.
basis.labourNote: Labour at the tab's bid-date prevailing rates: the run's open-shop labour x the contract's labour ratio (D-1103, unchanged).
basis.salesTaxNote: MUD water, sewer and drainage tabs: no sales tax on material. The comparison carries none.

excludeFromTuning.why: Temporary low-water-crossing culvert, removed at the end of construction: removal is not modelled (D-1272 item 11).
Temporary low-water-crossing culvert, removed at the end of construction: removal is not modelled (D-1272 item 11).

overlay.addNothingNote: Already in our direct cost (the crews, the spreads and their minimums).

indirects.separatelyPaidNote: Bonds, staking, SWPPP, silt fence, traffic control, dewatering and trench safety are paid as their own pay items where the tab lists them: no overlay is added for them on the pipe items.

ohp.note: One markup layer: Div 01 and OH&P inside the unit prices.

overlay.formula: L' = L x (1 + supervision + small tools); E' = E x (1 + supervision); bid = (L' x (1 + OH&P labour) + E' x (1 + OH&P equipment) + M x (1 + OH&P material) + S x (1 + OH&P subcontract)) / (1 - GL insurance - bond)

calibration.method: least squares on the log ratio, one point per contract: ln k = mean over contracts of ln(target / our direct); the $-weighted ratio (sum target / sum direct) beside it
calibration.founderExpectation: A market-level direct sits about 23-25 % below the median bid.
